info.syllabusName: Information System Analysis and Design_Phân tích và thiết kế HTTT
info.timeAllocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
info.description:
This course aims to explain to students all aspects of analysis and design an information system. Students will learn how to translate business requirements into information systems that support a company’s strategic objectives. Students will improve their analytical reasoning, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills when they do projects, assignments, and read other support materials in this course. This course is designed to:

- explain about systems analysis and design

- introduce project management concepts early in the systems development process.

- provide multi-method coverage, including a comparison of structured, object-oriented, and agile systems development methods.

- explain how IT supports business requirements in today’s intensely competitive environment.
info.studentTasks:
- Students must attend more than 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination.

- Student is responsible to do all exercises given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time

- Constantly follow announcements on intranet/LMS at http://lms.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information regarding assignment submission and feedback on assignments and project work.
info.tools: UML and UML graphical drawing tool
info.note:
1) On-going Assessment

- 3 progress tests: 15 %

- 3 labs : 15%

- 1 system analysis and design project: 35%

2) Final exam (60'): 35%

3) Final Result: 100%

Completion Criteria:

1) Every on-going assessment component >0

2) Final Exam Score >=4 & Final Result >=5

clos.loDetails: To understand the role of information technology in today’s dynamic business environment.
To be able to translates the logical design of an information system into a physical blueprint - system architecture
To understand how to concentrate on quality assurance throughout the activities of application development, coding, testing, documentation, and installation.

To understande systems support and security tasks that continue throughout the useful life of the
system
To be able to analyze the business case
To understand about project management and how to plan, schedule, monitor, and report on IT projects.
To comprehend the requirements engineering process
To understand data and process modeling techniques that analysts use to show how the system transforms data into useful information
To understand object modeling techniques that analysts use to create a logical model
To be able to do evaluation of alternative solutions and to perform preparation of the system requirements document
To understand how to design an effective user interface and how to handle data security and control issues
To enhance the data design skills that are necessary for a systems analyst to construct the physical model of the information system
